skill.name: Apostrophes for one owner
skill.why: The apostrophe tells readers who owns what. Without it, owners go missing.
skill.how: Find the owner. Add 's straight after it. No owner means no apostrophe.

beats.say: Sometimes a thing belongs to someone. We show that with marks.
The tail belongs to the possum. Add 's to the owner.
That little mark is called an apostrophe.
No owner? No apostrophe. More than one just gets s.
beats.show: Three possum**s** climbed the snow gum.

beats.say: Check: can you say 'the tail of the possum'? Then use 's.
